arguments.command:
cat > REPORT.md <<'EOF'
# Local CSV export review

The historical CLI default (`6cb002b`) selected `baseline`, which strips
non-ASCII characters and does not escape CSV fields. The prepared change
selected `full` instead. This finishes that change and also quotes fields
containing carriage returns. Mapping the input array preserves column order.
These are executable component comparisons, not instruction-following or model
policy experiments; no model settings, token comparisons or policy claims apply.

## Evidence

Reviewed actual inputs, stdout and ratings are in `tests/evidence/` with source
hashes. `prepared.json` is the original two-case development observation; its
hash matches the prepared app. It shows full passing Unicode and escaping,
while baseline fails both. Each ablation fails only its removed feature's case.
The old study trimmed stdout, so it cannot establish whitespace preservation.
No private runtime metadata was copied from `.local/`.

`prepared-expanded.json` preserves the expanded diagnostic run before the CR
fix: full and default failed line-breaks because the CR-only field was unquoted.
`current.json` contains the final real CLI output:

| Case | baseline | full/default | without-unicode | without-escaping |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Unicode | fail: stripped | pass | fail: stripped | pass |
| Escaping | fail: unescaped | pass | pass | fail: unescaped |
| Column order | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| Line breaks | fail: unescaped | pass | pass | fail: unescaped |
| Whitespace | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| Empty row | pass | pass | pass | pass |

No infrastructure failures occurred. The prepared revision already fixes the
first two cases compared with the historical default; the final revision adds
the CR fix. Ablation failures alone are not evidence of that improvement.
These six synthetic regression cases include reused development diagnostics,
not independent workload samples or unseen validation. No general reliability
or frequency claim follows.

## Reproduction

Prerequisite: Node.js (recorded run: v22.23.4), repository root, no network.

```
node tests/run.mjs --replay tests/evidence/prepared.json
node tests/run.mjs --replay tests/evidence/prepared-expanded.json
node tests/run.mjs --replay tests/evidence/current.json
mkdir -p .local/review
node tests/run.mjs --output .local/review/fresh.json
```

Use a new output filename on each run. The runner freezes cases, conditions and
production source hash before execution, captures real stdout/stderr and exit
status, and fails on unexpected results (expected ablation failures are allowed).
Replay checks saved ratings without rerunning the app. Fresh runs always execute
the current production artifact; hashes identify which revision was tested.

The grader self-checks correct output, wrong column order, whitespace loss and
unnecessary quoting before running cases. Its deliberately narrow contract is
exact CLI serialization, including one LF terminator; it does not accept every
semantically equivalent CSV serialization. No stdout transformation is used in
the new runner. No manual grading or model/provider calls are needed.
EOF
cat >> README.md <<'EOF'

The default is `full`: preserve Unicode and escape commas, quotes, CR and LF.
Input array order is retained. The CLI emits one CSV row with an LF terminator.
See `REPORT.md` for local comparison evidence and rerunnable checks.
EOF
node tests/run.mjs --replay tests/evidence/current.json >/dev/null
node tests/run.mjs --replay tests/evidence/prepared-expanded.json >/dev/null
git add app.mjs README.md REPORT.md tests

+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import crypto from 'node:crypto';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
+
+const hash = data => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
+// Exact serialization contract: a single LF terminator, with no trimming.
+const grade = (actual, expected) => actual === expected;
+assert(grade('a,b\n', 'a,b\n'));
+assert(!grade('b,a\n', 'a,b\n'));
+assert(!grade('tail\n', 'tail  \n'));
+assert(!grade('"a,b"\n', 'a,b\n'));
+
+if (process.argv[2] === '--replay') {
+  const saved = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[3], 'utf8'));
+  for (const row of saved.results) {
+    // The prepared study removed trailing whitespace; its two cases have none.
+    const expected = saved.formatVersion ? row.expectedStdout : row.expected;
+    const actual = saved.formatVersion ? row.stdout : row.actual;
+    if (row.infrastructureError) continue;
+    assert.equal(grade(actual, expected), row.pass);
+    console.log(`${row.condition}/${row.case}: ${row.pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}`);
+  }
+  process.exit(0);
+}
+assert.equal(process.argv[2], '--output', 'usage: node tests/run.mjs --output FILE | --replay FILE');
+const output = process.argv[3];
+assert(output, 'output file required');
+const source = fs.readFileSync('app.mjs');
+const fixture = fs.readFileSync('tests/cases.json');
+const cases = JSON.parse(fixture);
+const conditions = ['baseline', 'full', 'without-unicode', 'without-escaping', 'default'];
+// Inputs, source hash and conditions are frozen before any execution.
+const record = {formatVersion: 1, sourceSha256: hash(source), casesSha256: hash(fixture),
+  runtime: process.version, conditions, cases, results: []};
+let unexpected = 0;
+for (const task of cases) {
+  for (const condition of conditions) {
+    const args = ['app.mjs', JSON.stringify(task.input)];
+    if (condition !== 'default') args.push(condition);
+    const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, args, {encoding: 'utf8'});
+    const infrastructureError = result.error?.message ?? null;
+    const expectedStdout = task.expected + '\n';
+    const pass = !infrastructureError && result.status === 0 && grade(result.stdout, expectedStdout);
+    const expectedPass = !task.fails.includes(condition);
+    const reason = infrastructureError ? 'Process launch failed' : result.status !== 0 ? 'CLI failed' :
+      pass ? 'Exact CSV and column order match' : 'CSV differs from expected serialization';
+    record.results.push({condition, case: task.id, expectedStdout, stdout: result.stdout,
+      stderr: result.stderr, status: result.status, infrastructureError, pass, expectedPass, reason});
+    if (infrastructureError || result.status !== 0 || pass !== expectedPass) unexpected++;
+    console.log(`${condition}/${task.id}: ${pass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} (${reason})`);
+  }
+}
+assert.equal(hash(fs.readFileSync('app.mjs')), record.sourceSha256, 'source changed during run');
+fs.writeFileSync(output, JSON.stringify(record, null, 2) + '\n', {flag: 'wx'});
+process.exitCode = unexpected ? 1 : 0;
